# Retail vending vector kit

These are the active vector assets shared by the Alien Market and Neon machine styles. They contain no embedded raster data, dynamic text, blur filters, or interaction surfaces. HTML and scoped CSS remain authoritative for labels, state colors, product art, focus, and pointer behavior.

| File | View box | Role |
| --- | ---: | --- |
| `machine-frame.svg` | 1600 x 1400 | Asymmetric dark appliance chassis with corner armour, vent slats, service hardware, and sparse fasteners |
| `machine-header-frame.svg` | 1600 x 260 | Stepped header housing with broad bevel faces and asymmetric accent plates |
| `slot-frame.svg` | 420 x 620 | Reusable compartment shell with top housing, side pillars, lower shelf, and information-plate mass |
| `terminal-frame.svg` | 700 x 1100 | Purple-accented bolted control subsystem with connector hardware |
| `product-display-frame.svg` | 520 x 360 | Scanner pod with chunky brackets and a physical pedestal ring |
| `retrieval-bay.svg` | 1600 x 260 | Layered retrieval surround with bezel, cavity, interior floor, and guide strip |
| `warning-plate.svg` | 320 x 160 | Commercial yellow caution plate with icon area and hazard striping |
| `mascot-plate.svg` | 220 x 220 | Original alien mascot sticker backing for localized thank-you copy |
| `conduit.svg` | 100 x 600 | Ribbed purple service cable with curved routing and connector collars |

Keep replacement assets text-free and preserve the existing view boxes. Dynamic color and state feedback should stay in `styles/vending-machine-styles.css`.
